title: gyaarweh moula ki hoti hai shahadat haaye haaye
body:
Gyaarweh moula ki hoti hai shahadat haye haye
Samere me kyu na barpa ho qayamat haye haye
Seena o sar peet kar roe'n na kyu kar mominee'n
Ho rahe hai aaj moula ham se ruqsat haye haye
<<DIVIDER>>
Puchiye qairul bashar se, haidare karrar se
Samera me kis ki hai shahadat haye haye
Keh rahi hai qaak udha kar murtaza se fatima
Askari ki zehr se hai ghair haalat haye haye
<<DIVIDER>>
Ho rahe hai'n aaj hilmi hazrate hujjat yateem
Kya qayamat hai yateemi aur ghurbat haye haye
